CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.meta (key text PRIMARY KEY, value text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.documents ( digest text PRIMARY KEY, type text NOT NULL, body bytea NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.log ( log_id text NOT NULL, seq bigint NOT NULL, hash text NOT NULL UNIQUE, prev text NOT NULL, kind text NOT NULL, record bytea NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (log_id, seq))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.intake ( id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), body bytea NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.charters (charter_id text, version bigint, digest text, seq bigint)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.suspensions (charter_id text, principal text, key text, seq bigint)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.mandates (mandate_id text, version bigint, digest text, issuance text, seq bigint)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.approvals (digest text, intake bigint, principal text, decision text, subject_type text, subject_digest text, resolution text, seq bigint)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.refusals (intake bigint, digest text, seq bigint)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.lineage (mandate_id text, event text, digest text, detail text, seq bigint)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.tickets (ticket_id text, digest text, mandate_id text, class text, event text, detail text, seq bigint)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.warrants (warrant_id text, digest text, ticket_id text, ticket_digest text, action text, resolution_digest text, basis text, seq bigint)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fid_upgrade.executions (warrant text, event text, detail text, seq bigint)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.refuse() RETURNS trigger
            LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $$
            BEGIN
              RAISE EXCEPTION 'fiduciary: % is append-only', TG_TABLE_NAME
                USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
            END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.put_document(p_digest text, p_type text, p_body bytea)
            RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
            SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $$
            BEGIN
              IF p_digest <> encode(sha256(p_body), 'hex') THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'fiduciary: a document is stored under its digest'
                  USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
              END IF;
              INSERT INTO fid_upgrade.documents (digest, type, body) VALUES (p_digest, p_type, p_body)
                ON CONFLICT (digest) DO NOTHING;
            END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.submit(p_body bytea) RETURNS bigint
            LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $$
              INSERT INTO fid_upgrade.intake (body) VALUES (p_body) RETURNING id
            $$
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS refuse_change ON fid_upgrade.documents
CREATE TRIGGER refuse_change BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON fid_upgrade.documents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.refuse()
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS refuse_truncate ON fid_upgrade.documents
CREATE TRIGGER refuse_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON fid_upgrade.documents FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.refuse()
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS refuse_change ON fid_upgrade.log
CREATE TRIGGER refuse_change BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON fid_upgrade.log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.refuse()
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS refuse_truncate ON fid_upgrade.log
CREATE TRIGGER refuse_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON fid_upgrade.log FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.refuse()
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS refuse_change ON fid_upgrade.intake
CREATE TRIGGER refuse_change BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON fid_upgrade.intake FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.refuse()
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS refuse_truncate ON fid_upgrade.intake
CREATE TRIGGER refuse_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON fid_upgrade.intake FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fid_upgrade.refuse()
DO $$ BEGIN CREATE ROLE fid_upgrade_service NOLOGIN; EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$
DO $$ BEGIN CREATE ROLE fid_upgrade_intake NOLOGIN; EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$
DO $$ BEGIN CREATE ROLE fid_upgrade_audit NOLOGIN; EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$
REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA fid_upgrade FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA fid_upgrade FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA fid_upgrade FROM PUBLIC
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA fid_upgrade TO fid_upgrade_service, fid_upgrade_intake, fid_upgrade_audit
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA fid_upgrade TO fid_upgrade_service, fid_upgrade_audit

GRANT INSERT ON fid_upgrade.charters, fid_upgrade.suspensions, fid_upgrade.mandates, fid_upgrade.approvals, fid_upgrade.refusals, fid_upgrade.lineage, fid_upgrade.tickets, fid_upgrade.warrants, fid_upgrade.executions TO fid_upgrade_service
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION fid_upgrade.append_record(text, bigint, text, text, text, bytea), fid_upgrade.put_document(text, text, bytea) TO fid_upgrade_service
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION fid_upgrade.submit(bytea) TO fid_upgrade_intake
